label: deepwiki
_comment: Public, no auth. Ask questions about any GitHub repo's docs/architecture.

label: github
_comment: Set GITHUB_MCP_PAT in ~/.env (a GitHub PAT), then flip enabled to true.

label: notion
_comment: Set NOTION_MCP_TOKEN in ~/.env, then flip enabled to true.

label: stripe
_comment: Set STRIPE_MCP_KEY (restricted key) in ~/.env, then flip enabled to true.

label: cloudflare
_comment: Create a Cloudflare API token and set PJ_CLOUDFLARE_READ_ALL_RESOURCES in ~/.env (token only, no quotes).

label: microsoft-outlook
_comment: Microsoft Outlook Mail and Calendar. Set the URL issued by your chosen MCP provider after completing Microsoft OAuth. Keep disabled until configured and reviewed.
